posts.title: The one where I witnessed First Contact
posts.description: In the summer of 2019, I was visiting Bir, helping out at Hillhacks . It’s great fun - you talk tech, art and policy in the day, and sit next to a campfire in the night, perhaps with some peppered-up rice mead. posts.title: I don't like traveling anymore
posts.description: One of my biggest motivators to make money in my early 20s was traveling. I would book one way tickets to places near and far, enjoy the nature, the food, the culture, and the lovely people. I would come back a slightly wiser, friendlier and happier person.
